task: SparseTrack vs ByteTrack: Multi-Object Tracking with Pseudo-Depth Hierarchical Association

method_contract.SparseTrack: Pseudo-depth estimation to decompose dense target sets into sparse subsets, then hierarchical association within each depth layer. Objects closer to camera (larger bbox area) are tracked first.
method_contract.ByteTrack: Two-stage association: first match high-score detections to trackers, then match unmatched trackers with low-score detections.
method_contract.SORT: Baseline: Kalman filter + Hungarian algorithm with single-stage IoU-based association.

target_artifacts.code/tracker.py: Tracker implementations (SORT, ByteTrack, SparseTrack) + MOT metrics
